analysis.executiveSummary: The proposed trade sends elite 24-year-old RB De'Von Achane to Corgi Loaf Baking Co. in exchange for D'Andre Swift, Wan'Dale Robinson, and a 2027 1st-round pick (projected mid-range). While the raw numeric AVI sum of the incoming package appears higher, this deal violates core package realism principles by trading an S-tier cornerstone for secondary depth pieces ('3 dimes for a dollar'). Crucially, for a team committed to winning the championship, downgrading from Achane (97.4 C-AVI) to Swift (76.7 C-AVI) at starting RB2 significantly lowers weekly lineup points and damages championship odds.
